title: Agents
authorize.title: Allow {client} to access {site}?
authorize.user: The agent acts as {user}, with the permissions of your role.
authorize.client.verified: The client identity is published at {host}.
authorize.client.unverified: The client registered itself. Its identity is not verified.
authorize.redirect.web: After your decision, you go back to {host}.
